ran: favicon (§6) — torah: the tab DID declare an icon, the file it named never existed, and the answer came from the portal
follows: QA/platform/favicon-mounts-0810/_results.json — torah was one of the five mounts in the 'declares-but-lands-on-origin' group. Four of that group remain after this round: imud, chizukim, studio (all /favicon.png).

measured_before_touching.the_named_file_did_not_exist: apps/01-torah-platform/public/ held .gitkeep and logo.svg.placeholder only — no favicon.* of any kind. The previous round's production probe of /torah/favicon.svg returned 200 with text/html 29,186 bytes, which is the SPA shell, i.e. absent.
measured_before_touching.why_the_declaration_missed: href="/favicon.svg" is root-absolute, and a mount that sits under a path resolves it against the origin, not against the mount. Vite does NOT prefix this line with base — checked on dist/index.html, which carried "/favicon.svg" verbatim after a build with base "/torah/".
measured_before_touching.so_the_line_was_worse_than_absent: it made the mount count as 'declares an icon' while the file it named was never loaded once — the same shape found on egod in the previous round.

what_the_navbar_actually_draws.measured: getComputedStyle on the live header tile at more30.com/torah
what_the_navbar_actually_draws.not_a_graphic_mark: Navbar.tsx:60-66 renders an only when tenant.branding.logo_url is set. In production it is not set, so the second branch draws a letter tile.
what_the_navbar_actually_draws.the_letter_is_the_tenant_s_not_the_syste: the branch draws site_name.charAt(0). The tenant this mount serves is «איגוד מגידי השיעורים», so the live letter is א — not the ת fallback written in the code.
what_the_navbar_actually_draws.separate_latent_bug_not_fixed_here: the tile is h-10 w-10 (40x40) but measures 35.7 wide on the live page — flex is compressing it, so the 'square' tile is not square. Recorded, not touched.
what_the_navbar_actually_draws.contrast: white on rgb(26,47,91) is 13.3:1 — far above the 3:1 minimum for non-text graphics, so unlike egod no token pair had to be swapped here.

the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.first_attempt_failed_and_the_screenshot_: א was hand-traced as three strokes. It rendered as a Latin X — the upper-left arm and lower-right leg came out near-collinear and merged through the centre. A second attempt, re-traced off a 400px render of the real glyph on a 50px grid, still read as X. The tracing was abandoned rather than shipped.
the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.chosen: lucide Mic — the mark BrandLogo.tsx:1,20 draws, i.e. the system's own sign rather than one tenant's initial
the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.copied_verbatim: both paths and the line come from node_modules/lucide-react/dist/esm/icons/mic.js (v0.462.0); nothing was drawn by hand
the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.ratios_from_BrandLogo: tile w-9 (36px) with glyph w-4 (16px) = 44.4%. On a 64 side that is a 28.4 box centred, i.e. translate(17.8) scale(1.1833) over lucide's 24 box. Radius: rounded-xl (12px) on 36 = 33.3%; the rect uses rx 22.4, which is the navbar's own measured 14/40 instead.
the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.one_value_deliberately_not_the_live_one: stroke-width. lucide draws 2, which at this scale is 2.37 on a 64 side and under one pixel at 16px. Written as 2.8.
the_glyph_choice_and_why_it_is_not_the_l.a_bug_found_on_the_way: BrandLogo.tsx asks for bg-gradient-gold and text-navy. Neither name is defined in src/index.css or tailwind.config.ts (index.css defines .text-gradient-gold, a different name, and the config has no navy colour). The platform's own brand mark therefore renders with no tile background and no glyph colour wherever BrandLogo is mounted — Footer.tsx:69 and RoleSelection.tsx:19. NOT fixed here; the pair used in this icon is the one measured live in the navbar, not the one the code asks for and does not get.

verified_on_a_real_render.how: vite build, then vite preview on base /torah/ at 127.0.0.1:4371, then a real Chromium page load
verified_on_a_real_render.not_grep: the check is the resolved href in the live DOM, the request the browser itself issued, and the bytes returned
verified_on_a_real_render.built_href_is_not_double_prefixed: dist/index.html carries href="/torah/favicon.svg" exactly as written — Vite neither stripped nor duplicated the base
verified_on_a_real_render.browser_actually_requested: http://127.0.0.1:4371/torah/favicon.svg — captured on the first load of this declaration as initiatorType "other", 1,220 bytes encoded, no query string. On the re-check after the final asset was written the entry was absent because the browser served it from cache.
verified_on_a_real_render.domparser: no parsererror — the two-hyphen XML-comment trap was avoided up front
verified_on_a_real_render.decode: resolved at 16, 32, 64 and 128; naturalWidth 64 at each
verified_on_a_real_render.origin_root_favicon_svg: 404 — the fallback production takes is not reachable here

not_claimed: no screenshot of a tab icon: it lives in the browser chrome, not the viewport. mark-vs-navbar.png shows the asset drawn as an at 16/32/64/192 beside a clone of the live navbar tile at 40 and 192.

at 16px the microphone's head and stand nearly merge — it reads as a mark, not as a legible microphone. No ICO or PNG was written, so a client that ignores SVG icons still falls through to the origin.
the icon does not follow the tenant. If /torah is ever pointed at a different tenant the navbar letter changes and this file does not.
